granted_by: maintainer (formal authorization message of 2026-10-23 UTC: H1 P1g + P2 formal phase, $50)
decision: Maintainer formally approves continuing H1: P1g GPU validation, P2's four formal A/B student-recovery units, complete capability evaluation, statistical analysis and closeout, as one phase; P2 follows a passed P1g without a further approval

fixed.m1: 614 steps; A 7 blocks per step, B 2

P1g.scope: H1 P1g GPU validation: real packs, the frozen recipe, resume, persistence and the evaluation path; never a formal result

P2.scope: H1 P2: the four frozen formal units (A and B x two seeds), their evaluation on all of eval-set-1, and their closeout

ceiling_scope: CUMULATIVE over P1g and P2: every attempt, every provider resource and the network volume's full storage cost together; no session or attempt receives a fresh allocation; an estimate is not a spend target
_occupancy_basis: the recorded conservative occupancy before this phase: provider all-time $661.5161 plus P1t's $0.6447 all-in, counted once whether or not the provider has posted it; re-reconciled against a fresh provider snapshot before each launch, never double counted, and the cap is not raised by a new snapshot

storage.rule: its whole cost (booked at its reservation until retired or trued up) is inside the ceiling; no unbounded continuing charge

gpu: any GPU suited to the measured load inside the ceiling; not restricted to earlier types; GPU work goes to a GPU
on_failure: ordinary engineering failures are repaired inside the envelope; valid completed work is reused (a trained unit is scored, an interrupted one resumed, a scored one never rerun); a seed with a complete valid result is never rerun
terminal: SUCCESS, a scientific terminal (GO / NO_GO / INCONCLUSIVE / NOT_RESOLVED / FLOOR by the frozen rules) or a hard boundary (the envelope, the project cap, unknown billing, untrustworthy artifacts, a needed protocol change)
not_authorized: any change to arms, data proportions, objective, seeds or scoring
